description: Renders the lyric video in 1080p without a watermark, as 16:9 (landscape) or 9:16 (vertical). Requires the user's LyricVideoGenerator account: it uses 1 credit from their plan (or is free if this song was already unlocked on the website). Credits are refunded if the render fails. Returns an exportId; the widget shows progress and the download link.

aspect.description: 16:9 for YouTube, 9:16 for TikTok / Reels / Shorts
